conventions.byte_offsets: UTF-8 byte offsets, 0-based, end exclusive, into the exact JSON string's UTF-8 encoding
conventions.decoder_logits: per case: 'logits' are the reference pre-softmax logits; 'log_probs' is the exact decoder input torch produced (F.log_softmax(logits.float(), -1)). Use log_probs for a bit-exact decoder check.
conventions.float_files: raw little-endian float32 (numpy '<f4'), row-major [T, C], batch squeezed; no header, no byte order mark — Data(contentsOf:) + bindMemory(to: Float.self)
conventions.n_ctx_override_reason: opf hard-codes n_ctx=4096 for device='cpu'; 128000 is the checkpoint's default_n_ctx and the value opf itself uses on CUDA. Unobservable for every short text (single window under both values, verified structurally) and required for the long document to be a full-mask reference instead of halo-less 4096-token windows.
conventions.redaction: opf OPF(...device='cpu', context_window_length=128000, trim_whitespace=True, discard_overlapping_predicted_spans=False, output_mode='typed', decode_mode='viterbi') with the checkpoint's default viterbi_calibration.json (all-zero biases); placeholder is the upper-cased label in angle brackets
conventions.span_labels: opf base labels, never BIOES: one of O (never emitted), account_number, private_address, private_date, private_email, private_person, private_phone, private_url, secret
conventions.span_selection: opf trim_whitespace=True then _select_non_overlapping_spans: sort by (start, -(end - start), label), greedy keep non-overlapping, sorted by start
conventions.token_byte_offsets: per-token prefix sums of tiktoken decode_single_token_bytes(token_id); the concatenated pieces equal the input's UTF-8 bytes exactly
conventions.token_ids: tiktoken o200k_base, encode(text, allowed_special='all'); no special tokens added
